key: ["At Thanjavur, Rajaraja raises a granite tower sixty metres high, and consecrates the temple himself in 1010. Its walls keep the accounts. The villages that owe it paddy and gold. And four hundred temple women, every one of them named. The Cholas are now the masters of the peninsula.", "sarvam:varun_en_suspense@en-IN", "+6%", "+0Hz", null, 1.0, 0.0, "v3"]
